column1: # Settings for the no-regret checks: the reader exists, the gate class has
# not moved. clause<TAB>key<TAB>value<TAB># reason
# Most of these clauses stay `pending` in docs/index.md. A reader is built
# ahead of the owner choosing the real number and reviewing the gate-class
# change separately; until then every finding these checks emit reports as
# advisory, never as a failure, so no consuming repo can go red from a
# number nobody has chosen yet.
# A `#provisional` reason is a signal check-clause-index.sh reads: it is what
# lets a pending clause be named by a real script here without that reading as
# the usual "implemented but the row was never updated" rot. DB-1 is the one
# row without it: its gate class moved to `auto`, so its setting is no longer
# a placeholder ahead of a decision — it is the decision, reviewed with the
# gate-class change itself, the same review the `#provisional` marker exists
# to avoid needing for everything else here.
